description: Get item details by name or numeric ID — English effect text (the latest in-game description when PokéAPI has no effect text), category, versioned purchase and sell prices, fling power, item attributes (holdable, consumable, etc.), sprite URL, Pokémon that commonly hold it, and, for a TM, TR, or HM, the move it teaches in each version group.

identifier.description: Item name (e.g. "Poké Ball", "choice-specs", "tm25") or numeric ID as a string.

version_group.description: PokéAPI version-group name (e.g. "scarlet-violet"). Limits machine rows to this group.

name: pokeapi_get_item

cost.description: Legacy Pokédollar cost when supplied. Null when unavailable; zero is a literal amount. Independent of versioned prices.

effectText.description: PokéAPI's full English effect description. When it has none, the latest English in-game flavor text, folded to one line and named by effectTextVersionGroup. Null when neither exists.

effectTextVersionGroup.description: Version group whose in-game flavor text effectText carries. Null when effectText is PokéAPI's effect description or absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier resolves to no item in PokéAPI. `invalid_version_group`: The supplied version_group is not a known PokéAPI version-group name. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

flingPower.description: Fling move base power when this item is flung. Null if not throwable.

heldByPokemon.description: Pokémon that commonly hold this item in the wild.

machines.description: One row per version group in upstream order. Empty for items that are not machines, or when version_group names a group without a row. Unless effectTextVersionGroup names a group, effectText is one description for every group and can name another move.

items.description: The move a TM, TR, or HM teaches in one version group.

move.description: Move this item teaches in the version group. Null when its machine record could not be read; notices name the group.

versionGroup.description: Version group this machine row applies to.

notices.description: Notices about version-group selection and machine records that were not read.

prices.description: All supplied price records in upstream order. Empty when no records are available.

items.description: One version and currency price record.

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in this currency and version group. Null means not purchasable; zero is a literal amount.

sellPrice.description: Sell price in this currency and version group. Null means not sellable; zero is a literal amount.

versionGroup.description: Version group these prices apply to.

shortEffectText.description: PokéAPI's short English effect summary. Null when unavailable, including whenever effectText is flavor text.

spriteUrl.description: Item sprite URL. Null when no sprite is available.

title: Get Item
